items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: in the band was Kid Ory, Barney Bigard, Charlie Beal, Bud Scott and myself... I played bass.

ctx.x: Right. And you were reminded of something. Right?
Yes, I was reminded...what was I reminded of...? There's Barney Bigard who's gone, Pops, Bud Scott, Kid Ory, Zutty Singleton. Charlie Beal suffered a stroke
